errors.text_span: лявата ос, обозначена с проценти, показва дяловете на потребителски стоки и инвестиционни стоки
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly claims the left Y-axis is only for the blue and red lines. In fact, all three data series (blue, red, and green) use the left Y-axis for their values, which all fall within the 15-45% range.

errors.text_span: Дясната ос, също в проценти, показва дяловете на суровини, материали и енергийни ресурси
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the right Y-axis is used for the green line (raw materials). The green line's values range from approximately 20% to 40%, which are all represented on the left axis. The right axis (45-65%) is present on the chart but is not used by any of the plotted data lines.

errors.text_span: с интервали от 5% и етикети на 15%, 20%, 25%, 30%, 35%, 40% и 45%
errors.evidence: The description of the left Y-axis is incorrect. The chart shows major gridlines and labels at 15%, 25%, 35%, and 45%, indicating intervals of 10%, not 5%.
The description of the right Y-axis is incorrect. The chart shows labels at 45%, 49%, 53%, 57%, 61%, and 65%, indicating intervals of 4%, not 2%.
The description claims the lines use round markers. The chart clearly shows solid lines with no markers at all. This claim is repeated for all three lines.
The description states the green line dropped to 30% in 2016. The chart shows this value is actually the lowest point for the line, at approximately 20%.
The description states the green line peaked at 37% in 2011. The chart shows the peak is higher, at approximately 39-40%.
